title: 頂管中繼推進站
summary: 本課以頂管中繼站的分段受力、行程相容與局部接觸為主線，從分段推力與反力連續與多缸合力與偏心檢核建立系統邊界，再把管列彈性壓縮與位移差、曲線管列與徑向作用連到站體閉合與通水淨空。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on intermediate-jacking segment forces, stroke compatibility and local contact. It begins with Segment thrust and reaction continuity and Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity, links Pipeline elastic compression and displacement differences and Curved pipe strings and radial action, and ends with Station closure and hydraulic clearance. Intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查分段推力與反力連續：frontDemand=120 m*8 kN/m+400 kN=1360 kN; rearFriction=180 m*8 kN/m=1440 kN；再獨立檢查多缸合力與偏心檢核：idealResultant=8*20 MPa*0.010 m2=1.60 MN; sevenCylinders=1.40 MN。若同壓八缸其中一缸無有效輸出，理想合力由 1.6 降至 1.4 MN，還會改變合力位置；不能只按八分之七評估安全。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 將比較套筒間隙、全行程密封檢查與滲水時序作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Segment thrust and reaction continuity: frontDemand=120 m*8 kN/m+400 kN=1360 kN; rearFriction=180 m*8 kN/m=1440 kN. Independently check Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity: idealResultant=8*20 MPa*0.010 m2=1.60 MN; sevenCylinders=1.40 MN. Losing one effective cylinder from eight equal-pressure cylinders reduces ideal resultant from 1.6 to 1.4 MN and shifts its location; a seven-eighths capacity ratio alone cannot establish safety. The two results are not a complete design because intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. Use compare sleeve clearance, full-travel seal inspections and leakage timing as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分段推力與反力連續」與「多缸合力與偏心檢核」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Segment thrust and reaction continuity" and "Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分段推力與反力連續：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Segment thrust and reaction continuity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分段推力與反力連續」如何影響頂管中繼推進站的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Segment thrust and reaction continuity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Intermediate jacking stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中繼站將前後管列分開推進，使單段所需軸力小於整列一次推動的總需求，但每個階段仍需連續反力路徑。前段包含機頭阻力，後段則有自身摩阻；兩者不能直接當成同時疊加在每個接頭的荷載。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄；若出現反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分段推力與反力連續」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intermediate stations advance leading and trailing pipe sections separately, reducing the force associated with moving the whole string at once. Every stage still needs a continuous reaction path. The leading section includes head resistance while the rear has its own friction; these are not simultaneous loads at every joint. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records. If an incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Segment thrust and reaction continuity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：frontDemand=120 m*8 kN/m+400 kN=1360 kN; rearFriction=180 m*8 kN/m=1440 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: frontDemand=120 m*8 kN/m+400 kN=1360 kN; rearFriction=180 m*8 kN/m=1440 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「中繼站能推進前段而完全不需要後方提供反力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An intermediate station advances front pipes without any reaction from behind" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分段推力與反力連續」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 分段推力與反力連續：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分段推力與反力連續」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Segment thrust and reaction continuity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：frontDemand=120 m*8 kN/m+400 kN=1360 kN; rearFriction=180 m*8 kN/m=1440 kN。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: frontDemand=120 m*8 kN/m+400 kN=1360 kN; rearFriction=180 m*8 kN/m=1440 kN. Intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 分段推力與反力連續：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Segment thrust and reaction continuity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分段推力與反力連續」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Segment thrust and reaction continuity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 行程餘量與幾何相容：機制與系統路徑

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 行程餘量與幾何相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「行程餘量與幾何相容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check cylinder extension, joint opening and independent front and rear pipeline movement. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignoring pipe compression predicts positive reserve while a cylinder reaches its travel boundary. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check cylinder extension, joint opening and independent front and rear pipeline movement. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignoring pipe compression predicts positive reserve while a cylinder reaches its travel boundary, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring pipe compression predicts positive reserve while a cylinder reaches its travel boundary. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 推力環將離散缸力散布到管端，環的彎曲剛度和接觸平整度決定分配範圍。單缸力除有效接觸面可檢查局部量級，不能以全環面積沖淡峰值；接觸邊緣與管端劈裂仍需結構分析。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照推力環平整度、接觸壓痕及管端環向裂縫；若出現環變形使單缸力集中到窄邊，平均全環壓力仍顯示很低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「推力環局部承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A thrust ring distributes discrete cylinder forces into pipe ends, with bending stiffness and flatness controlling the spread. Dividing one cylinder force by its effective footprint checks local scale. Averaging over the entire ring conceals peaks; edge contact and pipe-end splitting need structural assessment. steps.instruction: 中繼站伸縮套筒需在相對移動中保持水密，密封方向和有效壓力面積取決於構造。水壓合力只是作用之一，偏心、砂粒與刮傷可能先破壞密封；靜態水密合格不能代表全行程循環後仍無損傷。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較套筒間隙、全行程密封檢查與滲水時序；若出現砂粒刮傷在伸縮後形成漏水通道，靜止試驗未曾顯現，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「伸縮套筒與水密邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
